companyIntro.heading: Integrated MEP Solutions Built on Over Three Decades of Engineering Excellence
companyIntro.description:
Established in the UAE in 1994, MENASCO is a trusted MEP contractor delivering integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection & specialized engineering solutions for complex, high-performance developments across the region.

Our capabilities span engineering & BIM coordination, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning & final handover. By bringing multiple engineering disciplines together under one integrated delivery approach, we help clients achieve greater coordination, operational reliability, energy efficiency, quality & long-term value.

Today, MENASCO supports commercial, residential, hospitality, infrastructure, industrial & mission-critical projects through its operations and capabilities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt & the United Kingdom.

prefabrication.heading: Manufactured with Precision. Installed with Confidence.
prefabrication.description:
MENASCO’s off-site manufacturing & MEP prefabrication capabilities support faster, safer & more consistent project delivery. Through controlled production environments, we manufacture HVAC ductwork & prefabricate selected MEP components & modular assemblies in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications & quality standards.

By completing more work away from the construction site, we help improve quality control, reduce material waste and site congestion, minimize installation risks & accelerate on-site progress across large-scale and technically demanding projects.

qualitySafety.heading: Quality, Safety & Environmental Responsibility at Every Stage
qualitySafety.description:
At MENASCO, quality, health, safety & environmental responsibility are integrated into every stage of project delivery from engineering coordination & procurement to installation, testing, commissioning & final handover.

Our QHSE management system establishes clear procedures, responsibilities, inspections, risk controls & performance monitoring to support consistent quality, safer workplaces, environmental compliance and continuous improvement across our operations & project sites.
